verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יְהוָ֛ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֧ם בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Again the Israelites . . . did evil in the sight of the LORD so [He] delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ אֶחָ֧ד אִ֨ישׁ מִצָּרְעָ֛ה וּשְׁמ֣וֹ מָנ֑וֹחַ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת הַדָּנִ֖י וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ עֲקָרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָלָֽדָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’e·ḥāḏ ’îš miṣ·ṣā·rə·‘āh ū·šə·mōw mā·nō·w·aḥ mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ had·dā·nî wə·’iš·tōw ‘ă·qā·rāh wə·lō yā·lā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah from the clan of the Danites whose wife [was] barren and had no children

verses.original: מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֵּרָ֥א אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א אַתְּ־ עֲקָרָה֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלַ֔דְתְּ וְהָרִ֖ית וְיָלַ֥דְתְּ בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh way·yê·rā ’el- hā·’iš·šāh way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā hin·nêh- nā ’at- ‘ă·qā·rāh wə·lō yā·laḏt wə·hā·rîṯ wə·yā·laḏt bên
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her It is true . . . that you are barren and have no children but you will conceive and give birth to a son

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ נָ֔א הִשָּׁ֣מְרִי וְאַל־ תִּשְׁתִּ֖י יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֑ר וְאַל־ תֹּאכְלִ֖י כָּל־ טָמֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nā hiš·šā·mə·rî wə·’al- tiš·tî ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār wə·’al- tō·ḵə·lî kāl- ṭā·mê
verses.literal: Now please be careful not to drink wine or strong drink and not to eat anything unclean

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנָּ֨ךְ הָרָ֜ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֗ן לֹא־ וּמוֹרָה֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הַנַּ֖עַר יִהְיֶ֥ה נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים מִן־ הַבָּ֑טֶן וְה֗וּא יָחֵ֛ל לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nāḵ hā·rāh wə·yō·laḏt bên lō- ū·mō·w·rāh ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- rō·šōw kî- han·na·‘ar yih·yeh nə·zîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm min- hab·bā·ṭen wə·hū yā·ḥêl lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: For behold you will conceive and give birth to a son And no razor shall touch . . . his head because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb and he will begin the deliverance - of Israel from the hand of the Philistines

verses.original: הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וַתָּבֹ֣א וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֤ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ כְּמַרְאֵ֛ה מַלְאַ֥ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֣א וְלֹ֤א שְׁאִלְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ אֵֽי־ מִזֶּ֣ה ה֔וּא וְאֶת־ לֹֽא־ הִגִּ֥יד לִֽי׃ שְׁמ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: hā·’iš·šāh wat·tā·ḇō wat·tō·mer lə·’î·šāh lê·mōr ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bā ’ê·lay ū·mar·’ê·hū kə·mar·’êh mal·’aḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mə·’ōḏ nō·w·rā wə·lō šə·’il·tî·hū ’ê- miz·zeh hū wə·’eṯ- lō- hig·gîḏ lî šə·mōw
verses.literal: So the woman went and told her husband . . . A man of God came to me His appearance was like the angel of God exceedingly awesome I did not ask him where he came from - and he did not tell me his name

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְעַתָּ֞ה אַל־ תִּשְׁתִּ֣י׀ יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֗ר וְאַל־ תֹּֽאכְלִי֙ כָּל־ טֻמְאָ֔ה כִּֽי־ הַנַּ֔עַר יִהְיֶ֣ה נְזִ֤יר אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־ הַבֶּ֖טֶן עַד־ י֥וֹם מוֹתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî hin·nāḵ hā·rāh wə·yō·laḏt bên wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tiš·tî ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār wə·’al- tō·ḵə·lî kāl- ṭum·’āh kî- han·na·‘ar yih·yeh nə·zîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm min- hab·be·ṭen ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw
verses.literal: But he said to me Behold you will conceive and give birth to a son Now, therefore do not drink wine or strong drink and do not eat anything unclean because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb until the day of his death

verses.original: מָנ֛וֹחַ וַיֶּעְתַּ֥ר אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בִּ֣י אֲדוֹנָ֔י אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֗חְתָּ יָבוֹא־ נָ֥א אֵלֵ֔ינוּ עוֹד֙ וְיוֹרֵ֕נוּ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַנַּ֥עַר הַיּוּלָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: mā·nō·w·aḥ way·ye‘·tar ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar bî ’ă·ḏō·w·nāy ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer šā·laḥ·tā yā·ḇō·w- nā ’ê·lê·nū ‘ō·wḏ wə·yō·w·rê·nū mah- na·‘ă·śeh lan·na·‘ar hay·yūl·lāḏ
verses.literal: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD - Please O Lord let the man of God - You sent us come . . . to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born

verses.original: הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע בְּק֣וֹל מָנ֑וֹחַ מַלְאַךְ֩ הָאֱלֹהִ֨ים וַיָּבֹ֣א ע֜וֹד אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וְהִיא֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אִישָׁ֖הּ וּמָנ֥וֹחַ אֵ֥ין עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl mā·nō·w·aḥ mal·’aḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō ‘ō·wḏ ’el- hā·’iš·šāh wə·hî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ baś·śā·ḏeh ’î·šāh ū·mā·nō·w·aḥ ’ên ‘im·māh
verses.literal: And God listened to the voice of Manoah and the angel of God returned . . . to the woman as she was sitting in the field but her husband Manoah was not with her

verses.original: לְאִישָׁ֑הּ וַתָּ֖רָץ וַתַּגֵּ֣ד וַתְּמַהֵר֙ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה הִנֵּ֨ה הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥א אֵלָֽי׃ בַיּ֖וֹם נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙
verses.transliteration: lə·’î·šāh wat·tā·rāṣ wat·tag·gêḏ wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw hā·’iš·šāh hin·nêh hā·’îš ’ă·šer- bā ’ê·lāy ḇay·yō·wm nir·’āh ’ê·lay
verses.literal: The woman ran . . . quickly to tell her husband Behold the man who came to me the [other] day has reappeared . . .

verses.original: מָנ֖וֹחַ וַיָּ֛קָם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הַאַתָּ֥ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אָֽנִי׃ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר
verses.transliteration: mā·nō·w·aḥ way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ’iš·tōw way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·’îš way·yō·mer lōw ha·’at·tāh hā·’îš ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tā ’el- hā·’iš·šāh ’ā·nî way·yō·mer
verses.literal: So Manoah got up and followed . . . his wife When he came to the man he asked Are you the man who spoke to my wife I am, ” he said

verses.original: מָנ֔וֹחַ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עַתָּ֖ה דְבָרֶ֑יךָ יָבֹ֣א מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה הַנַּ֖עַר מִשְׁפַּט־ וּמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·nō·w·aḥ way·yō·mer ‘at·tāh ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā yā·ḇō mah- yih·yeh han·na·‘ar miš·paṭ- ū·ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: Then Manoah asked When your words come to pass what will be the boy’s rule of life and mission

verses.original: מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מָנ֑וֹחַ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה תִּשָּׁמֵֽר׃ מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֶל־
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer mā·nō·w·aḥ hā·’iš·šāh tiš·šā·mêr mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·mar·tî ’el-
verses.literal: So the angel of the LORD . . . answered Manoah Your wife is to do everything - I told her . . .

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאכַ֗ל מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵא֩ מִגֶּ֨פֶן הַיַּ֜יִן תֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וְיַ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ אַל־ תֹּאכַ֑ל וְכָל־ טֻמְאָ֖ה אַל־ תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתִ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵal mik·kōl ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê mig·ge·p̄en hay·ya·yin tê·šət wə·ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār ’al- tō·ḵal wə·ḵāl ṭum·’āh ’al- tiš·mōr kōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wî·ṯî·hā
verses.literal: She must not eat anything that comes from the vine . . . nor drink any wine or strong drink nor eat anything unclean . . . She must do everything - I have commanded her

verses.original: נָּ֣א נַעְצְרָה־ אוֹתָ֔ךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אֶל־ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְנַעֲשֶׂ֥ה גְּדִ֥י עִזִּֽים׃ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: nā na‘·ṣə·rāh- ’ō·w·ṯāḵ mā·nō·w·aḥ ’el- way·yō·mer mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wə·na·‘ă·śeh gə·ḏî ‘iz·zîm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Please stay here - Manoah . . . said to the angel of the LORD and we will prepare a young goat . . . for you

verses.original: מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶל־ מָנ֗וֹחַ אִם־ תַּעְצְרֵ֙נִי֙ לֹא־ אֹכַ֣ל בְּלַחְמֶ֔ךָ וְאִם־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עֹלָ֔ה תַּעֲלֶ֑נָּה לַיהוָ֖ה כִּ֚י מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי־ לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע הֽוּא׃ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mā·nō·w·aḥ ’im- ta‘·ṣə·rê·nî lō- ’ō·ḵal bə·laḥ·me·ḵā wə·’im- ta·‘ă·śeh ‘ō·lāh ta·‘ă·len·nāh Yah·weh kî mā·nō·w·aḥ kî- lō- yā·ḏa‘ hū mal·’aḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the angel of the LORD replied Even if I stay I will not eat your food But if you prepare a burnt offering offer it to the LORD For Manoah . . . did not know [that] it [was] the angel of the LORD

verses.original: מָנ֛וֹחַ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֶל־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה מִ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ וְכִבַּדְנֽוּךָ׃ דִבְרֶיךָ יָבֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: mā·nō·w·aḥ way·yō·mer ’el- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh mî šə·me·ḵā kî- wə·ḵib·baḏ·nū·ḵā ḏiḇ·rɛ·ḵå̄ yā·ḇō
verses.literal: Then Manoah said to the angel of the LORD What is your name so that we may honor you when your word comes to pass

verses.original: לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה תִּשְׁאַ֣ל לִשְׁמִ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לּוֹ֙ וְהוּא־ פֶ֛לִאי׃ס
verses.transliteration: lām·māh zeh tiš·’al liš·mî way·yō·mer mal·’aḵ Yah·weh lō wə·hū- p̄ɛ·li
verses.literal: Why . . . do you ask my name said the angel of the LORD - since it is beyond comprehension

verses.original: מָנ֜וֹחַ אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֨ח גְּדִ֤י הָעִזִּים֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עַל־ הַצּ֖וּר לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּמָנ֥וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ רֹאִֽים׃ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת וּמַפְלִ֣א
verses.transliteration: mā·nō·w·aḥ ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ gə·ḏî hā·‘iz·zîm wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh way·ya·‘al ‘al- haṣ·ṣūr Yah·weh ū·mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’iš·tōw rō·’îm la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ū·map̄·li
verses.literal: Then Manoah - took a young goat . . . - and a grain offering and offered them on a rock to the LORD And as Manoah and his wife looked on the LORD did a marvelous thing

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ הַלַּ֜הַב בַעֲל֨וֹת מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יְמָה מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיַּ֥עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ בְּלַ֣הַב וּמָנ֤וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ֙ רֹאִ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hal·la·haḇ ḇa·‘ă·lō·wṯ mê·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ haš·šā·may·māh mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh way·ya·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ bə·la·haḇ ū·mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’iš·tōw rō·’îm way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: - When the flame went up from the altar to the sky the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame When Manoah and his wife saw [this] they fell facedown . . . to the ground

verses.original: מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־ לְהֵרָאֹ֖ה יָ֤סַף עוֹד֙ אֶל־ מָנ֣וֹחַ וְאֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אָ֚ז מָנ֔וֹחַ יָדַ֣ע כִּֽי־ הֽוּא׃ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wə·lō- lə·hê·rā·’ōh yā·sap̄ ‘ō·wḏ ’el- mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’el- ’iš·tōw ’āz mā·nō·w·aḥ yā·ḏa‘ kî- hū mal·’aḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again . . . to Manoah and his wife - Manoah realized that it [had been] the angel of the LORD

verses.original: מ֣וֹת נָמ֑וּת מָנ֛וֹחַ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ כִּ֥י רָאִֽינוּ׃ אֱלֹהִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: mō·wṯ nā·mūṯ mā·nō·w·aḥ way·yō·mer ’el- ’iš·tōw kî rā·’î·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: We are going to die . . . he said to his wife for we have seen God

verses.original: אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וַתֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ לוּ֩ יְהוָ֤ה חָפֵ֨ץ לַהֲמִיתֵ֙נוּ֙ לֹֽא־ לָקַ֤ח עֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֔ה מִיָּדֵ֙נוּ֙ וְלֹ֥א הֶרְאָ֖נוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה הִשְׁמִיעָ֖נוּ וְכָעֵ֕ת לֹ֥א כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ’iš·tōw wat·tō·mer lōw lū Yah·weh ḥā·p̄êṣ la·hă·mî·ṯê·nū lō- lā·qaḥ ‘ō·lāh ū·min·ḥāh mî·yā·ḏê·nū wə·lō her·’ā·nū ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh hiš·mî·‘ā·nū wə·ḵā·‘êṯ lō kā·zōṯ
verses.literal: But his wife replied If the LORD had intended to kill us He would not have accepted the burnt offering and the grain offering from our hands nor would He have shown us all these things or spoken to us . . . this way

verses.original: הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וַתֵּ֤לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן הַנַּ֔עַר וַיִּגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָֽה׃ וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: hā·’iš·šāh wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw šim·šō·wn han·na·‘ar way·yiḡ·dal Yah·weh way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū
verses.literal: So the woman gave birth to a son and named - him Samson The boy grew and the LORD blessed him

verses.original: ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַתָּ֙חֶל֙ לְפַעֲמ֖וֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־ דָ֑ן בֵּ֥ין צָרְעָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין אֶשְׁתָּאֹֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ Yah·weh wat·tā·ḥel lə·p̄a·‘ă·mōw bə·ma·ḥă·nêh- ḏān bên ṣā·rə·‘āh ū·ḇên ’eš·tā·’ōl
verses.literal: And the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan . . . between Zorah . . . and Eshtaol
